text:
LANG Studio seeks a skilled Architectural Designer with 5–12 years of experience to join our New York City firm, with an immediate focus on a large, complex townhouse renovation in Manhattan.
We are a design-focused architecture and real estate development firm seeking a proven leader and collaborator committed to design excellence and a holistic approach to architectural practice. The ideal candidate brings significant experience in high-end residential architecture, including the design and execution of at least one substantial New York City townhouse renovation.
What You’ll Do
Lead the design and execution of a significant NYC townhouse renovation, from design development through construction administration.
Drive design development, technical detailing, material selection, and construction documentation.
Coordinate clients, consultants, and contractors, managing project timelines, budgets, and deliverables.
Navigate the technical, regulatory, and construction complexities of renovating historic NYC buildings.
What We’re Looking For
Professional degree in Architecture from an accredited institution.
5–12 years of professional experience, including at least 1 year in a project leadership role.
Direct, substantive experience on at least one significant NYC townhouse renovation, with meaningful involvement in design development, construction documentation, consultant coordination, and/or construction administration.
Demonstrated experience in high-end residential architecture, with custom homes and complex renovations strongly preferred.
Strong command of design development, technical detailing, and construction documentation.
Working knowledge of NYC building codes, permitting processes, and construction practices.
Highly developed skills in client communication, consultant coordination, and construction administration.
Advanced proficiency in Revit, AutoCAD, Rhino, and Adobe Creative Suite.
Deep understanding of materials, construction systems, and building methodologies.
Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining design and technical rigor.
How to Apply
Please submit a single PDF (max 10MB) including:
- Cover letter
- Resume
- Minimum of five work samples, clearly indicating your role and responsibilities on each project
Send to: [email protected] (Please note: web links will not be accessed. Due to volume, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.)
